messages:
kai: hey team, first day snag. set up M1 Pro and kandji shows Enrolled but Supervision=false. i can't enable the USB token driver (shows 'system extension blocked') and `fdesetup status` says FileVault On locally but the recovery key in kandji doesn't match the reported key on my device. sudo says i'm not in sudoers. any quick help?

it-teal: welcome! paste serial and the output of `fdesetup status` + `profiles status -type enrollment`. if the FV keys disagree we'll escrow a new key after verifying identity. we can give short temp admin to accept the extension and finish migration.

kai: serial C02M1PRO9999, `fdesetup status` -> "FileVault is On." kandji shows recovery key: XXXXXX-XXXXXX but running `fdesetup list` on device shows a different key ID. profiles shows "No enrolled profiles." usb token d/l vendor says to allow kernel extension com.vendor.usbsec.

mdm-ops: looks like supervision didn't apply in ABM tag sync. i'll reassign supervision, trigger FV escrow, and push a temp admin for 45 minutes for you to accept the system prompt. enroll-bot queued jobs.

enroll-bot: Job queued: assign_supervision -> device=C02M1PRO9999 (job=112233)
enroll-bot: Job completed: assign_supervision -> success (supervision=true)

mdm-ops: pushing FV re-escrow and local-admin deploy now. do NOT reboot until the escrow completes.

enroll-bot: Job started: push_fv_escrow_112234 -> device=C02M1PRO9999
enroll-bot: Job completed: push_fv_escrow_112234 -> success (new_recovery_key_escrowed)
enroll-bot: Job started: push_temp_admin_112235 -> device=C02M1PRO9999
enroll-bot: Job completed: push_temp_admin_112235 -> success (kai added to /etc/sudoers.d/temp-admins)

kai: i can sudo now, clicked Allow on Security & Privacy and the USB token driver installed. confirmed `fdesetup list` key id matches kandji now. thanks!

mdm-ops: leaving temp admin for 45 mins. file a note if you installed extra drivers. we'll revoke after you confirm cleanup. filing follow-up to tighten ABM tag sync window.

kai: removed test drivers and local keys, all set. revoke temp admin when convenient. thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
